faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents / Senior Demonstrators Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies available for Senior Residents and Senior Demonstrators positions across various departments at AIIMS Rewari under advertisement number SR/02/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form for AIIMS Rewari?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy of the offline application form for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents and Senior Demonstrators recruitment is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate medical degree such as MD, MS, DNB, or MDS in the respective specialty. For non-medical demonstrator posts, an M.Sc. or Master's degree with a Ph.D. is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents / Senior Demonstrators?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Age relaxations are provided for reserved category candidates as per government rules, including 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for medical candidates selected as Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Medical candidates selected for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary as per Pay level 11, amounting to Rs. 67,700 per month plus usual allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download the offline application form from the official website, fill it out completely, attach self-attested documents and a Demand Draft, and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Rewari recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 1500/- for General/OBC candidates, Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/EWS candidates, and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Rewari Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications and documents followed by a personal interview carrying 100 marks and final document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application form must be sent to the Office of the Executive Director, AYUSH Block, Ground Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Majra Rewari, Haryana, 123102.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of AIIMS Rewari?
faq.answer: The official website of AIIMS Rewari is https://aiimsrewari.edu.in/, where candidates can find the notification PDF, application form, and further recruitment updates.
